summary: Screen solar, biogas and storage options against farm energy needs. Explore the five-day course and plan your next assessment.
lede: Renewable energy planning for farms helps operations managers, agricultural engineers and energy officers match renewable options to seasonal farm loads. This foundation-level course covers building load profiles, screening solar PV, water-pumping, biogas and battery options, and comparing costs with simple payback and lifecycle-cost methods. Practical exercises use farm records and basic calculations to create option shortlists and action roadmaps, while detailed engineering design and installation remain outside its scope.
audienceIntro: This foundation course suits people who work with farm energy demand, equipment or investment choices and need a structured way to screen renewable options before commissioning detailed studies.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with farm operations, energy bills or equipment schedules is useful. No coding or programming is required; detailed electrical engineering and renewable-system design experience are not prerequisites.
